what: A tiny hand-drawn figure (an ant) sits at the end of a link and carries a frame-cut sprite. On hover it flips through 60 frames in 1.3s, moving its legs, while walking left across the screen width over 100s and vanishing at the edge (on release it stays in place). look: flip does not walk, it only flips frames in place — a hidden gag for the store link and ”See more”

options.[data-fx-part=walker]: Walking-frame cell (child, position: absolute gives it the size of one frame). The overflowing strip is clipped
options.walker’s first child: Cut strip — inline SVG stacking cuts from top to bottom (with fill: currentColor it takes the skin’s text color) or . Make the last cell the same as the first (cut count + 1 cells)
options.--fx-walk: Walk duration, default 100s — original phone version 27s
options.look: flip: Cuts flip in place without walking (store version of the original first page)

use: ONLINE SHOP

from.where: news.html·about.html·level.html·article.html shop row .am-shop a — original a:hover span{animation: walk 100s linear forwards}(Phone 27s) · span::after{animation: flip 1.3s steps(60) infinite} Ant sprite, the first page’s shop panel uses flip only (look: flip)

note: Painting the strip with CSS mask-image is blocked as cross-origin when opened as a file (file://) so it doesn’t show — so it’s built to move child strips instead
